title: metadata-admin: PositionPreview tells an admin to bind a position to Permission Sets even when the position already declares `permissionSets`; it reads only name, label and description
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with reach measured**. The defect was measured in the browser by the os-dev on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2200 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2229, head `94033f97`). The run was on HotCRM with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a fresh `objectstack dev` plus `demo:staff`. That PR is what makes the defect visible: it declares `permissionSets` on five HotCRM positions. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

## The finding, as measured

- **Where:** Setup → Positions → `service_manager`, which declares `permissionSets: ['service_agent']`.
- **What is right:** the form's **Permission Sets** row shows "Service Agent `service_agent`", and the set's **Assigned Users** panel lists the holder "via position service_manager".
- **What is wrong:** the position's preview pane still reads "Positions don't grant data access on their own. Bind `service_manager` to one or more **Permission Sets**…". It says this for every position, bound or not.
- **Reach:** every admin reading a position that declares `permissionSets` (ADR-0131 D3/D4). The callout tells them to do what is already done. HotCRM's own card #2200 had read this same callout as "the position grants nothing on its own".
- **Evidence:** the dev's screenshot (`after-position-service_manager.png`) is kept in the dev's scratch and not published. The source reading below is enough to reproduce.

## Seat review (source at the tested pin `616df6598b42`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PositionPreview.tsx`:
  - reads `d.name`, `d.label` and `d.description` from the draft and nothing else;
  - renders `engine.positionPreview.noAccess` and `.bind` unconditionally (`:61-74`).
- Its header comment ("The Position schema is intentionally minimal — name / label / description") predates `PositionSchema.permissionSets` (ADR-0131 D4, the same form row objectui#12126 added).
- No commit after the pin touches the file (`616df6598b42..origin/main`).

**Direction (the reader's call):**
- When the draft declares `permissionSets`, list them. Keep "positions grant nothing on their own" only for a position that declares none.
- Update the header comment.

## Dedupe

**Method:** every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (every state, #7 to the newest, refreshed with `since=2026-10-20`), and every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title, listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint. Matched case-insensitively on `PositionPreview`, position preview, and position permission sets / binding. The search API is refused for this session.

**Results:**
- Related, closed:
  - objectui#12126 (the `ref-multi:permission` widget for the position form's `permissionSets` row);
  - objectui#12089 (Setup's positions read the registry).
- Neither covers the preview pane. **New.**
